notes.title: Update v1.0.1 — Optimization, Gamma Settings & Xbox Support
notes.notes:
Hi, guys!

Today we're releasing update v1.0.1 — it addresses key issues based on your feedback:
⚙️ Improved optimization across different graphics quality levels.
📋 Updated menu — navigation is now more intuitive and user-friendly.
🎛️ Added gamma adjustment option.
🎮 Xbox gamepad support is now available.
🐞 Fixed various bugs, including crashes and freezes.

We're continuing to work on the game — a new update is already on the way.
Thank you for staying with us!

Your team,
Sinka Games

notes.title: MosGhost Releases Today!
notes.notes:
🕘 The release is today at 9:00 PM Moscow time!

After moving to Moscow, Andrey rents a cheap apartment in an old Soviet building. But at night, strange things start happening—rustling in empty rooms, footsteps behind the walls, and the unsettling feeling that he is not alone. It seems the landlady has left something unsaid...

MosGhost is an atmospheric horror game where the darkness of old corridors hides more than it seems. Explore the apartment, listen to the night sounds, and try to uncover what is really happening.

Get ready—the doors open today. But will you be able to leave?

notes.title: Release postponement: our first bug and a bit of a reschedule
notes.notes:
Hi friends!

We wanted to share some important news with you. Unfortunately, we had to postpone the release date of our game. During the final stage of testing, we encountered a critical bug that we still can't figure out. It took us all day yesterday to find the cause, but so far to no avail.

We are very sorry to have to report this at the last minute. We are new to game development and this is all a great experience for us. We want our first game to be as good as possible, so we will try to sort out the problem as soon as possible.

We'll keep you informed and we'll be sure to tell you as soon as we have new information. Thank you very much for your patience, support and understanding - it is very important for us!

Sincerely, Sinka Games Team

notes.title: The MosGhost demo is already available at Steam Fest!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that a demo version of our new mystical game “MosGhost” became available at Steam Fest! In this demo you will be able to get acquainted with the gloomy atmosphere and start solving the mystery of the apartment, which turned out to be suspiciously cheap.

“MosGhost” is a story full of mysteries and frightening events. In the demo version you will see only a part of what awaits you in the full version, but already now you can immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere and feel what lies behind the walls of this strange apartment.

We have put a lot of effort into creating detailed graphics and atmospheric soundtrack to make your experience as immersive as possible. The full version of the game will reveal even more secrets and surprise you with new plot twists.

Try the demo today and tell us about your impressions! We are looking forward to your feedback and hope that “MosGhost” will leave you with unforgettable emotions.

Download the demo on Steam and start your journey into the world of “MosGhost”!

notes.title: The Ghosts Of The Old House
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/The_Ghosts_Of_The_Old_House/

Long-standing pain forced Jack to return to the old family home in search of answers. Find out the terrible truth that this house kept, and how it relates to what happened to his parents in the distant past.

Return to your parents ' old home and help Jack find answers to the questions that have plagued him since his father killed his wife and shot himself right in front of him.

Open up to a long-standing secret that will lead to unexpected and meaningful consequences.
